brief: How do I publish my first screen so visitors can see it?

candidates.note: A reference answer written by hand: the plain steps, the documentation it was given linked, and one technical paragraph.
candidates.answer:
Open the screen in the Besigner and press **Publish** in the top bar. The version you publish is what visitors see; your later edits stay in a draft until you publish again. See [Publishing a screen](https://docs.example.com/building-sites/publishing-a-screen) for what each option in the publish dialog does.

Under the hood: publishing marks that screen version as the live one for its route, so the next request for its path serves it.

controls.why: A link to a page the answer was not grounded in.
controls.answer: Press **Publish** in the Besigner. There is a longer guide at [this blog post](https://random.example.net/how-to-publish).
